title: Korean identity records for Valerianella locusta
summary: Korean records anchor Valerianella locusta to Korean names including 돌상추 and 상치아재비; 콘샐러드 is retained as a crop or market term and 램스레터스 as a retail transliteration.
limitations: Identity evidence only; not feeding-suitability evidence
Retail alias alone is not taxonomic proof
